mechanism.summary: Compile a separate compact execution stream for semantically ordinary bytecode and enter it from the existing VM, while retaining the current Op interpreter as the exact fallback.
mechanism.generality: Eligibility derives solely from bytecode op forms, frame and binding state, and runtime guards. It does not inspect benchmark names, source paths, function names, loop counts, or workload values. Unsupported bytecode and every guard failure retain the existing interpreter from the exact next instruction.
semantic_risks: the instruction pointer must be synchronized at every call, abrupt completion, jump, generator suspension, and fallback boundary
calls must retain argument order, receiver binding, errors and finally handling, direct eval, with, spread and iterator behavior, and completion propagation
unsupported bytecode must re-enter the original interpreter at the exact next operation without skipping or replaying effects
lowered virtual-object and loop-plan execution views must preserve original bytecode-offset mapping and existing deoptimization guards
